channel.title: Ente development digest
channel.description: AI-generated daily digest of PRs opened and merged in the Ente monorepo

item.title: Ente digest Nov 14, 2026 - 11 shipped, 6 in progress
item.description:
Today’s changes focus on smoother Ente Photos interactions, more reliable iOS downloads and editing, and improved Auth icon coverage. The staff portal and server also gained stronger account and upload controls, while several Photos performance fixes are now in progress.

Shipped

  • Photos mobile: The selection sheet now keeps its controls visible as it expands, avoiding clipped or duplicated actions (#14580). iOS video downloads preserve the Ente capture date and avoid saving duplicates when a download is tapped again (#14583). Original crop mode now preserves aspect ratios and better restores editing state, including undo and redo history (#14581). Old photo review reopens faster, adds a completion animation, and improves scrolling for large libraries (#14558).
  • Locker mobile: Search now filters by items or collections and supports selecting multiple results for existing actions (#14592).
  • Accessibility: Decorative HugeIcon elements no longer create empty image stops for screen readers (#14582).
  • Auth: Added recognizable icons for AIDA, TDSB, and UFile, plus a correction for the Nexo icon (#14587, #14568, #14584).
  • Administration and server: Staff can now suspend accounts and revoke their active sessions and device access (#14576). Upload URL issuance is rate-limited and expired multipart uploads can recover (#14579).

In progress

  • Photos performance: A proposed viewer change would show a sharper screen-sized preview sooner while large local photos decode (#14595).
  • Android navigation: Work is underway to prevent system back, home, and app-switch gestures from also triggering Photos swipes (#14594), and to open the left menu without bouncing the home grid (#14593).
  • People cover photos would be restored more reliably after sign-in, with retryable errors for failed updates (#14591).
  • Auth may add a PetriScan icon, while the server proposes tighter rate limits for small upload URLs used by free accounts (#14588, #14585).

item.title: Ente digest Nov 13, 2026 - 25 shipped, 7 in progress
item.description:
A busy day for Ente Photos, with improvements across accessibility, editing, Rewind, People, sharing, backups, and desktop uploads. Server work also strengthened upload controls and storage replication, while several upcoming Photos and infrastructure features are in progress.

Shipped

  • Photos mobile: Cropping now preserves the original aspect ratio and restores crop history correctly when reopening an edit (#14581). Backup can continue on networks reported as both Wi‑Fi and mobile data, while still respecting cellular-only settings (#14559).
  • Rewind and memories: Rewind cards now show more photos and refreshed wording, including improved shared-card language (#14546, #14574). Trip memories have better names, avoid including photos from home in overseas trips, and no longer leave empty slots between updates (#14556, #14575).
  • Photos web: People views now offer a dialog to filter by additional people and show loading placeholders during the first sync (#14557, #14554). Selection controls adapt to narrow windows, and shift-selection no longer remains stuck after switching tabs (#14505, #14494).
  • Accessibility: Mobile screen readers now get clearer button, search, overflow, and icon semantics (#14545, #14582).
  • Desktop and Auth: Watched folders no longer cancel an active manual upload (#13410), while Auth adds TDSB, UFile, and Hustix Macro issuer icons (#14568, #14501).
  • Server: Upload URL issuance is now limited and expired multipart uploads can be recovered (#14579); completed replication-copy records are cleaned up safely (#14552).
  • Documentation added updated Auth, Photos, and self-hosting FAQs plus mobile screenshots across Photos help pages (#14571, #14539).

In progress

  • Upcoming photobooks: Print ordering is being wired through Shopify and Prodigi, including PDF delivery and shipment tracking (#14577).
  • iOS video downloads will preserve capture dates and avoid duplicate saves when tapped repeatedly (#14583).
  • Photos selection sheets are being polished during expansion, and sharing will refresh participant details when opened (#14580, #14572).
  • Server work is preparing free-user upload limits, automatic B2/Wasabi hot-storage failover, and historical replication cleanup (#14585, #14566, #14567).

item.title: Ente digest Nov 12, 2026 - 24 shipped, 11 in progress
item.description:
Ente shipped several Photos improvements today, especially around people-based discovery, mobile upload and editing reliability, and Rewind. Desktop, server, documentation, and infrastructure work also landed, while new work is underway for smarter trips, accessibility, and social suggestions.

Shipped

  • Photos web: People views now support combining multiple people and browsing beyond the quick-filter row through a new picker dialog: multi-person filters and the people picker.
  • Photos mobile: Upload-related viewer actions now refresh after uploads and sync, manual video-backup requests are honored, and missing originals can be recovered for editing: viewer toolbar refresh, restore upload action, manual video backup, and editing recovery.
  • Photos mobile: Memories can now be shared as portrait videos with motion, transitions, and optional music via Share as video. Rewind also received interaction and card-content polish in the latest update.
  • Photos performance and reliability: Rust ML vector graphs are built at the end of runs instead of on every write, improving embedding-import performance in the vecdb update. Safer ICC parsing landed in the profile limits change, and stale local ML references are cleaned up by this Android fix.
  • Desktop: Photos now uses Electron’s protocol handler for development and packaged builds in the protocol migration, while model checksum verification prevents reuse of corrupt migrated models.
  • Space and access: Draft photos remain usable until posting in the draft-preview fix, the Space tab is now called Home in the navigation update, and legacy desktop PIN unlock returns in the compatibility fix.
  • Other: Server replication recovery was strengthened in this requeue fix. Updated support guidance shipped in the Photos FAQ update.

In progress

  • Photos: Improved trip naming and exclusion of home photos from trips abroad in this trip-detection update; a faster, more polished old-photo review in this review update; and richer Rewind cards in the Rewind ritual work.
  • People and accessibility: Loading placeholders for People are proposed in this web update, while mobile screen-reader improvements add clearer button and search semantics.
  • Social and platform work: Mutual-friend suggestions are proposed in this Space update. Shared location-radius logic across mobile, web, CLI, and Rust is being consolidated in this cross-platform change.

item.title: Ente digest Nov 11, 2026 - 16 shipped, 9 in progress
item.description:
Today’s changes focused on polishing Ente Photos, especially Rewind, gallery selection, and Android interaction reliability. Server-side indexing and restore improvements also make large operations faster and more resilient.

Shipped

  • Photos and Rewind: Rewind is now prepared before opening, removing its loading screen and improving face crops by using original files. Cached Rewind also respects hidden-person exclusions (#14503) and correctly groups locations around the International Date Line (#14493).
  • Safer gallery actions: Selecting more than 100 photos now requires confirmation, helping prevent accidental bulk selections.
  • Mobile fixes: Pending uploads no longer appear twice in deduplicated views, person-name suggestions open merge confirmation correctly (#14502), and photos in Device Trash can be deselected (#14495).
  • Web Photos: The Space tab is now Home, with a longer visible confirmation after private replies. Upload, download, and other notifications now share a bottom-right stack instead of obscuring controls (#14500).
  • Reliability and performance: Android Mali devices now skip unstable WebGPU indexing in favor of XNNPACK (#14517), while WebGPU quarantine is now device-wide (#14512). Server restore ownership checks now use one batch query, substantially reducing database work for large restores (#14408), with additional lookup indexes added in #14513.

In progress

  • Upcoming Rewind polish: Stricter ranking cards, improved place rules, photo zoom, and interactive photo strips are under review.
  • Photos usability: A responsive selection toolbar (#14505), smoother left-menu opening (#14499), gesture-navigation fixes (#14498), and faster local-photo viewer loading (#14497) are in progress.
  • Other work: Server replication recovery is being hardened (#14520), stale local ML records can be cleared safely (#14519), Play Store subscription replacements are being corrected (#14507), and Ente Auth is adding a Hustix Macro icon (#14501).

item.title: Ente digest Nov 10, 2026 - 1 shipped, 3 in progress
item.description:
Ente Photos shipped refinements to the Rewind experience, making its rankings and photo selections more representative. New work is also addressing selection edge cases on mobile and web, along with more accurate location clustering.

Shipped

  • Photos / mobile: Rewind follow-ups: real top-percent bands, better photo picks and polish replaces placeholder ranking thresholds with bands based on actual library sizes, including support for the top 0.1%. The Rewind page and scrapbook seal now show every band, and screenshots or WhatsApp/Downloads photos are only used after the user’s own photos have filled available slots.

In progress

  • Photos / mobile: Fix deselecting photos in device Trash fixes selection handling for locally identified files, so photos in the Device tab of Trash can be selected and deselected normally.
  • Photos / web: Fix reset shift key selection state on window blur prevents range selection from getting stuck after switching tabs or windows while holding Shift.
  • Photos / Rewind: Keep Rewind spots together at the date line improves clustering for photos near the International Date Line, keeping locations on either side of the longitude boundary together.

item.title: Ente digest Nov 09, 2026 - 1 shipped, 1 in progress
item.description:
Today’s activity included a usability fix for Photos on the web and an upcoming mobile video feature for iOS. The shipped change makes browser history behave correctly when moving between albums, while Picture-in-Picture is being prepared for Photos videos.

Shipped

  • Photos web: Album navigation now works correctly with browser Back and Forward. Returning to a previous album updates both the URL and the selected album without disrupting browser history.

In progress

  • Photos mobile for iOS: Picture-in-Picture support for videos adds a new video-player option to continue playback while viewing other apps or after closing the viewer. Playback preserves the current position, mute state, speed, and loop setting, and stops when the user logs out.

item.title: Ente digest Nov 08, 2026 - 3 shipped, 2 in progress
item.description:
Today’s shipped work focuses on reliability and consistency: the web app now shares collection-sort logic safely, while the server better handles interrupted database reads. In progress, web dependency updates and an Android Auth visual fix are being prepared.

Shipped

  • Photos web: Collection sorting hooks consolidated. Gallery and album selection now share sort-preference logic while retaining their separate settings, defaults, and validation. Expanded end-to-end coverage also protects all six sort orders.
  • Server: Database failures and incomplete reads are handled safely. Interrupted reads can no longer be silently treated as complete during authorization, passkey lookup, access resets, deletion, session, or file-data workflows, reducing the risk of skipped security and cleanup operations.
  • Web maintenance also removed an unused direct dependency in PR #14477.

In progress

  • Web: Selected patch dependencies are being updated across web workspaces, along with the npm lockfile. Most application tests pass; some failures are currently blocked by missing generated Photos/Space WASM and a timed-out wasm-pack download.
  • Ente Auth for Android: Secure recent-app thumbnails are being visually corrected. On Android 13 and newer, the task background and status bar will match the white app background, while existing screenshot protection remains unchanged.

item.title: Ente digest Nov 07, 2026 - 1 shipped, 4 in progress
item.description:
Today’s shipped work focused on improving server-side replication reliability and efficiency. In progress, the team is refining database failure handling and advancing several Ente Photos features, including video sharing, faster ML indexing, and Rewind.

Shipped

  • Server: Replication now selects work through destination-specific indexes, helping workers find files needing B2, Wasabi, or Scaleway replication more efficiently while preserving safe locking and retry behavior.

In progress

  • Ente Photos mobile: Share memories as video adds an internal-user sharing option that exports selected photos and videos as a portrait MP4 with motion, transitions, and optional music.
  • Ente Photos mobile: Build vector-search graphs after ML runs instead of on every write aims to speed up embedding imports by deferring HNSW graph construction until it is needed.
  • Ente Photos mobile: Rewind follow-ups improve the upcoming Rewind experience with accurate top-percent bands, better photo selection that prioritizes users’ own photos, and additional presentation polish.
  • Server: Handle database failures and incomplete reads adds checks so interrupted database scans cannot silently skip authorization, revocation, deletion, or cleanup work, while tightening related resource and subscription error handling.

item.title: Ente digest Nov 06, 2026 - 26 shipped, 5 in progress
item.description:
Ente shipped a broad set of Photos improvements, from a smoother old-photo review flow and refreshed editing tools to stronger export and app-lock behavior. Server-side storage replication also received a substantial reliability and performance pass, while several internal Rewind and ML improvements are moving forward.

Shipped

  • Photos mobile: Old-photo review now has clearer previews, forward month navigation, long-press selection, prompt progress updates, and a stable scrubber for large libraries in #14438. Selection actions now collapse into a scrolling row in #14426, and iOS app lock remains enabled after background launches in #14356.
  • Photo editing: Web and desktop editors gained 11 mobile filter presets with previews and non-destructive exports in #14445. The editor controls were also restyled for better narrow-screen access, with clearer Crop, Transform, Colors, Reset, and Save actions in #14433 and #14461.
  • Photobook: Mobile previews and desktop controls were improved, including a collapsible page sidebar and corrected hardcover previews in #14437. A manual deployment workflow is now available in #14436.
  • Storage and server reliability: Replication now supports B2 and Wasabi backfills, better destination-index selection, recorded hot-storage copies, and safer upload finalization across #14435, #14459, #14439, #14432, and #14434.
  • Exports: macOS Finder sidecar files no longer incorrectly make export destinations appear non-empty in #14452.
  • Additional shipped work includes Photos and Locker end-to-end tests in #14443, new Photos help pages in #14379, and a clearer ML indexing FAQ in #14458.

In progress

  • Share memories as video: Internal users will be able to export portrait MP4s with motion, transitions, and music in #14469.
  • Text layers: The web photo editor is gaining captions with font, color, alignment, and background controls in #14462.
  • Rewind 2026: Follow-up work improves top-percent rankings, photo selection, and polish in #14465.
  • Server database reads are being hardened against incomplete results and silent authorization or cleanup failures in #14471, while ML vector graphs are being built only after runs to speed indexing in #14467.

item.title: Ente digest Nov 05, 2026 - 37 shipped, 11 in progress
item.description:
Ente shipped a broad set of Photos improvements across uploads, editing, search, viewing, and people management, alongside backend storage and security work. Several larger experiences—including Rewind 2026 and improved Photobook and old-photo workflows—are also moving forward behind the scenes.

Shipped

  • Photos mobile: Failed uploads now show clear warning and retry actions, including separate messaging for partial and total failures (#14427). Cached People data is invalidated after deletion, and fixes prevent lost or failed updates when removing faces from people (#14183, #14405, #14401).
  • Photos web: The file viewer, file-info pane, and editor now use the newer island styling, while downloads display byte-based progress (#14396, #14400, #14424, #14386).
  • Photos performance and reliability: Large-library Memories computation is faster, recovery-key verification has a clearer success state, and expired SRP login sessions are handled across clients (#14411, #14398, #14397).
  • Rewind 2026: The service and initial mobile viewer, home tile, and Search entry are in place behind a disabled feature flag, so users do not see changes yet (#14423, #14430).
  • Locker: Single-file uploads now offer encrypted sharing after sync, search is substantially faster, and item counts and accessibility labels are corrected (#14420, #14399, #14422).
  • Auth and Ensu: Auth recognizes Polymarket accounts with the correct icon, and Ensu desktop now supports live voice transcription (#14322, #14353).
  • Server and infrastructure: Downloads can use recorded hot-storage copies, Wasabi uploads work through the proxy, and collection mutations now enforce app scope (#14432, #14429, #14402).
  • Documentation: Subscription deletion timelines, migration guidance, shared-album metadata, iOS backup behavior, and Photos/Auth support FAQs were clarified (#14377, #14373, #14418, #14417, #14415, #14367).

In progress

  • Photos: Improved old-photo review, a smoother selection-action row, and a combined, restyled editor are underway (#14438, #14426, #14433).
  • Photobook: Mobile preview improvements, better desktop controls, and a manual deployment workflow are proposed (#14437, #14436).
  • Ensu and subscriptions: Background response notifications and refined subscription and Locker-preview screens are in progress (#14431, #14406

item.title: Ente digest Nov 04, 2026 - 39 shipped, 14 in progress
item.description:
A busy day across Photos, mobile, and the Rust media pipeline brought several user-facing improvements, alongside substantial security and performance hardening. New work is also underway for faster Locker search, richer album controls, and desktop voice transcription.

Shipped

  • Photos web: Downloads now show byte-based progress for individual files, ZIPs, and desktop saves, while shared download state prevents duplicate downloads when opening a file mid-save (#14386, #14371). The All view also gains a date scrubber, and empty albums can upload directly into the current album (#14355, #14349).
  • Newly created albums now open immediately, dates follow the selected app language, and album-sharing panels receive a refreshed floating layout (#14345, #13959, #14351).
  • Photos mobile: Android OCR now uses the CPU to avoid WebGPU device-loss failures, recovery-key verification uses a clearer success icon, and onboarding/recovery-key actions have improved spacing (#14383, #14398, #14350). Nightly and release-candidate builds now include a downloadable Photos IPA alongside the APK (#14374).
  • Photos intelligence and media: Rust Discover embeddings now match phone-generated results, memory selection and calendar dates are more reliable across DST, and Rewind 2026 has been scaffolded. JPEG XL and HEIC decoding now use safer, bounded-memory paths, improving compatibility with large or unusual files (#14364, #14393, #14368, #14380, #14365, #14372, #14343).
  • Auth and security: Expired SRP login sessions are handled cleanly, SRP sessions expire after 30 minutes, and admin APIs are rate-limited (#14397, #14347, #14370). Live Photo extraction now uses bounded, safer streaming code (#14342).
  • Other merged work tightened server queries, improved backup preparation, and updated release/review automation.

In progress

  • Upcoming: Locker search is being optimized by reusing loaded data and removing an unnecessary delay, with a reported drop from roughly 490 ms to 20 ms in testing (#14399).
  • Photos web is getting a new “island” style file viewer, keyboard shortcuts for video volume, and filename sorting for mobile albums (#14396, #14359, #14358).
  • Other active work includes iOS app-lock preservation, bounded Apple Cast processing, authenticated download Workers, and desktop live voice transcription (#14356, #14394, #14354,

item.title: Ente digest Nov 03, 2026 - 35 shipped, 8 in progress
item.description:
A busy day for Ente, with several Photos web usability improvements, stronger mobile security, and performance work across Rust and the server. New work also targets easier album uploads, faster photobooks, and broader QA build coverage.

Shipped

  • Photos web: newly created albums now open automatically, while sharing and file-info panels receive a consistent floating design. The web video player also gains a volume slider, and a new activity Feed brings social activity into the navigation rail.
  • Photos cleanup: The CLI now supports listing and removing duplicates. Duplicate cleanup also protects files in hidden albums, and mobile can use the shared Rust implementation through Flutter Rust Bridge integration.
  • Mobile security and reliability: Photos, Auth, and Locker now store session tokens in Keychain or Keystore and migrate existing sessions without signing users out. Auth codes remain usable with large text sizes, and the Auth app is correctly named on macOS Apple-silicon installs.
  • Photos processing: HEIC grid images now use bounded, tile-by-tile decoding to reduce memory use. Mobile memories can also be computed through a new Rust-backed path for internal users.
  • Photobooks and desktop: Failed restore attempts no longer overwrite saved books, while desktop dialogs and drawers stay below the title bar via improved window positioning.
  • Space and server: Unfriending now blocks access to direct-message history. Other shipped work included decoder and ML performance improvements and routine infrastructure maintenance.

In progress

  • Photos QA: Publish matching iOS IPAs alongside nightly and RC APKs for BrowserStack testing.
  • Photos web: Add photos directly from empty albums.
  • Photobooks: Improve large-book performance and page layouts with nearby-page rendering and bounded image caches.
  • Rust and server: Bound Live Photo archive extraction memory, expire SRP sessions after 30 minutes, and reduce public-memory database queries.
  • Mobile onboarding spacing and a new Polymarket icon for Ente Auth are also in review.

item.title: Ente digest Nov 02, 2026 - 38 shipped, 6 in progress
item.description:
Today’s changes focus on safer, smoother photo management: secure session handling, faster gallery and ML operations, and more control over duplicates and shared content. Several upcoming Photos features also move toward richer activity and shared-album workflows.

Shipped

  • Photos mobile: Empty states for album search, Trash, Archive, and Links now use animated illustrations in #14315. Users can also hide shared items from the home gallery via a new layout-sheet toggle in #14305.
  • Security across mobile apps: Photos, Auth, and Locker now store session tokens in Keychain or Keystore rather than plaintext preferences, with existing sessions migrated automatically in #14262.
  • Photos cleanup: The CLI gains interactive and JSON-capable duplicate listing and removal commands in #14299. Web duplicate removal now runs through shared Rust logic while preserving album memberships in #14241. Internal mobile users also get a month-by-month “Review old photos” cleanup flow in #14176.
  • Photos performance: Overlapping album refreshes are coalesced during backup in #14308, while People suggestions use substantially less memory in #14307. Semantic-search fallback work is also kept in Rust instead of loading all vectors into Dart in #14298.
  • Web and platform safety: Shared album pages now provide lightweight video previews and Open Graph video metadata in #14294. HEIC and JPEG XL decoding received updated pins and additional bounds checks in #14316, #14282, and #14285.
  • Locker: Empty home states now consistently show save options and search in #14319.

In progress

  • Photos activity: A web navigation-rail Feed is being added, using encrypted social activity APIs and fresh in-memory loading in #14300.
  • Shared albums: Mobile users will be able to review, accept, or reject album invitations before content syncs in #14297. Encrypted album-share push notifications for internal iOS users are being enabled in #14295.
  • Duplicate cleanup is being hardened so files in hidden albums cannot be selected for removal in #14320; oversized video previews are also being rejected server-side in #14311.
  • Test reliability improvements will retry Museum and Postgres when ports collide in #14318.

item.title: Ente digest Nov 01, 2026 - 3 shipped, 3 in progress
item.description:
Ente Photos shipped several web improvements focused on gallery structure and clearer upload progress. In progress, Photos is exploring shared-link expiry reminders, while Ente Auth is adding iOS AutoFill and the CLI is improving export recovery.

Shipped

  • Ente Photos web: Links content is now organized in a dedicated view, laying groundwork for more maintainable link browsing while preserving the existing behavior (PR #14270).
  • Ente Photos web: Upload progress now floors percentages, so an upload at 99.82% is shown as 99% rather than prematurely appearing complete (PR #14271).
  • Ente Photos web: Gallery navigation now uses a dedicated actions context, an internal restructuring that preserves current navigation behavior and supports future maintenance (PR #14269).

In progress

  • Ente Photos mobile: Local reminders are planned for owned shared links expiring within 24 hours. The opt-in feature would check once per day, respect notification settings and permissions, omit hidden albums, and open Link settings when tapped (PR #14275).
  • Ente Auth: An opt-in iOS 18+ AutoFill extension would let users search and fill TOTP codes with device authentication. It includes encrypted synchronization with vault changes and revocation on disablement or logout (PR #14273).
  • CLI: ente export is being updated to retry HTTP/2 GOAWAY failures and exit with status 1 when an export ultimately fails, instead of stopping early and reporting success (PR #14272).

item.title: Ente digest Oct 31, 2026 - 20 shipped, 6 in progress
item.description:
Today’s shipped work focused on safer image processing, faster and more consistent ML-backed Photos behavior, and improved developer foundations across web, mobile, and Rust. In progress, secure session storage and recipient approval for shared albums stand out as notable upcoming changes.

Shipped

  • Photos security and reliability: [bounded image decoding] now rejects images exceeding 210 MP or 512 MiB, while [PNG decoding] also limits oversized source dimensions before processing.
  • Photos CLI: [Place-based listing and filtering] lets users list cities or countries and filter files by location, with case- and accent-insensitive matching.
  • Photos memories and ML: [people memories] and [CLIP memories] are now computed in Rust. Related [merge similarity] and [suggestion sorting] work also moves into the Rust ML store.
  • Ensu: [direct ONNX transcription] replaces transcribe-rs while preserving decoding and timestamps; [voice transcript spacing] fixes text such as “at 7” and “$25” being run together.
  • Auth: [Alternate and KIT icons] and an [X Networks icon] expand custom service branding.
  • Mobile: recovery-key mnemonic conversion now uses shared Rust code via [one common implementation]. A photo-sync coalescing change was subsequently reverted in [this follow-up].
  • Web gallery logic was refactored into hooks in [subscription handling], [authentication], and [slideshow state].

In progress

  • Mobile security: [secure session-token storage] moves Photos, Auth, and Locker tokens from plaintext preferences to Keychain/Keystore, with migration for existing sessions.
  • Photos sharing: [recipient acceptance for shared albums] would require invitees to accept before access is granted, behind a feature flag.
  • Image processing: [cooperative PNG-decoding cancellation] adds opt-in cancellation checkpoints.
  • Other open work includes [gallery navigation cleanup], [Photos documentation updates], and [Locker introduction emails].

item.title: Ente digest Oct 30, 2026 - 25 shipped, 5 in progress
item.description:
A busy day focused on moving shared logic into Rust, strengthening Photos reliability and security, and expanding CLI capabilities. Several internal ML and memory-processing paths also moved closer to consistent cross-platform behavior.

Shipped

  • Photos: Added explicit 210 MP and 512 MiB image-decode limits, turning potentially crash-inducing files into clean errors in PR #14244. Calendar and trip memories are now computed in shared Rust, preserving existing selection and cooldown rules (#14223, #14235).
  • Photos ML: More face clustering, reclustering, cluster-average refresh, and ML database cleanup now run in Rust, reducing data movement between Dart and native code and making failed database clears recoverable (#14214, #14224, #14239, #14245). The Rust ML backend is enabled for internal users after device smoke testing (#14217).
  • CLI: Added ente photos usage for storage, file counts, plans, and family details, plus filtering and sorting options for ente photos file list (#14226, #14212).
  • Authentication and shared code: Login, signup, password and two-factor flows now use shared Rust APIs on web and mobile (#14238), while recovery-key mnemonic conversion is unified across clients (#14225). Auth also improved Chromebook Play Store availability (#14233).
  • Security and reliability: Web now rejects unsafe passkey and billing URL schemes (#14216), detects truncated Photos downloads (#14220), and hardens Locker shared-file and item validation (#14219, #14222).

In progress

  • Locker outreach: A server change would send eligible new Photos users a one-time Locker introduction email (PR #14248).
  • Duplicate cleanup: Duplicate removal is being wired through shared Rust for web and future mobile use, including planning, key handling, album preservation, and progress updates (#14241, #14240).
  • Password updates are being separated from SRP refreshes so a confirmed password change can succeed even if the refresh fails (#14242). A Watch Folders FAQ is also in progress to clarify safe local deletion after upload (#14221).

item.title: Ente digest Oct 29, 2026 - 39 shipped, 15 in progress
item.description:
Ente shipped a concentrated set of Photos performance, reliability, and security improvements, alongside safer Locker and web flows. Development is continuing on Rust-backed people features, gallery UX, Space protections, and an internal Photos cleanup tool.

Shipped

  • Photos memories and ML: Calendar-based memories now have a Rust implementation covering On This Day, time-based, filler, and simple memories (#14223), while mobile fixes make date windows and photo ordering consistent (#14206). Internal users now exercise the Rust ML database, including Rust-based bulk face clustering and safer index switching and recovery (#14217, #14214, #14204).
  • Photos security and reliability: Web downloads now reject truncated authenticated streams, hidden files only target collections owned by the signed-in user, and server-supplied passkey and billing URLs are restricted to HTTP(S) (#14220, #14208, #14216).
  • Locker: Web shared items are schema-validated and unauthenticated file-link downloads are rejected; mobile Important removals now remain in owned collections (#14219, #14222, #14207).
  • Mobile and desktop: Locker launches correctly with the iOS 27 SDK (#14210), Android album-share notifications began rolling out with encrypted key enrollment (#14165, #14166), and desktop temporary media files are now private from other local users (#14199).
  • Photobook and web: Mobile previews, import improvements, and public-album import compatibility shipped (#14184, #14186).

In progress

  • Upcoming Rust face workflows: Removing photos from people or splitting clusters will run regrouping inside the Rust ML store instead of moving embeddings through Dart (#14224).
  • Photos improvements: A CLI file-listing upgrade adds filters and sorting (#14212), while web work moves deduplication rules into shared Rust code and replaces blocking gallery overlays with a loading bar (#14190, #14187).
  • Upcoming internal feature: “Review old photos” adds month-by-month cleanup to Free up space (#14176).
  • Space access protections and family storage-count fixes are also in review (#14182, #14181, #14215).

item.title: Ente digest Oct 28, 2026 - 36 shipped, 6 in progress
item.description:
Photos shipped a broad set of gallery, navigation, subscription, and sharing improvements across web and mobile. Under the hood, encrypted notifications, account security, and Rust integrations also advanced, while several performance and reliability fixes landed.

Shipped

  • Photos web: The gallery now checks for and shows the changelog as soon as it loads, without waiting for the first remote sync (#14168). Places gained searchable city/country filtering, clickable map entries, and a sidebar powered by the shared Rust location matcher (#14138, #14137, #14077).
  • Photos navigation and usability: Collapsing navigation now leaves the icon rail available, albums opened from the overview have a back button, and link-setting rows can be toggled by clicking anywhere on the row (#14156, #14141, #14159). Image loading no longer briefly flashes a checkerboard background (#14163).
  • Photos mobile: Subscription screens were redesigned with new plan, FAQ, family, and Locker cards while keeping billing behavior unchanged (#14060). People views now refresh face suggestions after removals, support smoother cover transitions, and have corrected navigation controls (#14155, #14078, #14158). Video previews and the crop editor are more reliable (#14151, #14129).
  • Encrypted notifications: Android users can now enroll notification encryption keys for album-share pushes (#14166), and the iOS notification extension can decrypt those events with a fallback for new activity (#13965).
  • Security and infrastructure: Account key validation now requires recovery setup, shared collection access is scoped to the authenticated app, and account deletion logic is shared through Rust across clients (#14160, #14152, #14153).
  • Other: Legacy kit emails now send a confirmation with a hosted illustration (#13925, #14149), and photobook gained a Rust PDF/X-4 writer for print exports (#14131).

In progress

  • Photos web: Subscription and family management are moving into Settings, with quota prompts linking directly to the subscription screen (#14169).
